# The Pawsitive Co

> > A dog product retailer dedicated to feeding dogs in need through stylish leashes, collars, and charitable initiatives.

The Pawsitive Co specializes in premium dog accessories including leashes and collars, with a mission-driven approach to supporting dogs in need. The brand offers curated pet gear designed with both style and purpose.
